description:
Drowning in debt, Choi Ihyun finally gets the chance to chase his dream of becoming an actor. While celebrating a small supporting role with a friend, he accidentally witnesses top star Baek Sungwoo engaged in a forceful outdoor tryst.

*That actor… was really like that?*

Before Ihyun can slip away unnoticed, their eyes meet.
Now, it seems Sungwoo has taken a troubling interest in him…

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/reuinion_trap), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/fake_trap)

**Official Translations:**
